functions.name: VALUE
functions.description: Returns a value from the cube, like CUBEVALUE. Give members by unique name, such as [Date].[Year].&[2025] or [Measures].[Sales].

parameters.name: connection
parameters.description: A Cube Explorer connection, such as "Sample cube", or "Name/Database/Cube" when it has several cubes.

parameters.name: member_expression1
parameters.description: A member's or measure's unique name, such as [Measures].[Sales], or a range of them. Not a CUBE.MEMBER cell: that one holds a caption.

functions.name: MEMBER
functions.description: Shows a member's caption once the cube confirms it exists, like CUBEMEMBER.

parameters.name: connection
parameters.description: A Cube Explorer connection, such as "Sample cube", or "Name/Database/Cube".

parameters.name: member_expression
parameters.description: A member's unique name, such as [Date].[Year].&[2025], or a range of names (a tuple: its last member is shown).

parameters.name: caption
parameters.description: Text to show instead of the cube's caption.

functions.name: MEMBERPROPERTY
functions.description: Returns a property of a member, such as its Key, like CUBEMEMBERPROPERTY.

parameters.name: connection
parameters.description: A Cube Explorer connection, such as "Sample cube", or "Name/Database/Cube".

parameters.name: member_expression
parameters.description: A member's unique name, such as [Geography].[City].&[Tehran].

parameters.name: property
parameters.description: The property's name, such as Key or Caption.

functions.name: RANKEDMEMBER
functions.description: Shows the caption of the n-th item of a set, like CUBERANKEDMEMBER. The set is written in MDX.

parameters.name: connection
parameters.description: A Cube Explorer connection, such as "Sample cube", or "Name/Database/Cube".

parameters.name: set_expression
parameters.description: An MDX set, such as TopCount([Geography].[City].Children, 10, [Measures].[Sales]).

parameters.name: caption
parameters.description: Text to show instead of the cube's caption.

functions.name: SETCOUNT
functions.description: Returns how many items a set has, like CUBESETCOUNT. The set is written in MDX.

parameters.name: connection
parameters.description: A Cube Explorer connection, such as "Sample cube", or "Name/Database/Cube".
